ingredients: Cheese spread: 12 oz whipped cream cheese
Burger: thinly sliced onion and jalapeño
instructions: Cheese spread: mix everything together and refrigerate for 30 minutes or more until ready to serve.
partial_note: Cheese spread is complete. Burger assembly steps are not written out in the post — see the original post for the rest.
title: Smashburger with Cheese Spread

instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the yogurt, buttermilk, and sour cream until smooth.
Add garlic powder, onion powder, and salt.
Stir in the parsley, dill, and chives.
Add lemon juice, starting with 1 tsp, and adjust to taste.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Serve as a dip or dressing.
title: Healthy Homemade Ranch

ingredients: Mayo: 2 tsp lemon juice or vinegar
Ranch: 2 tbsp each fresh dill, parsley, and chives, finely chopped
Ranch: 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder
instructions: Mayo: in a bowl or using an immersion blender, whisk the egg yolks, mustard, and lemon juice until smooth.
Mayo: slowly drizzle in the oil while whisking constantly until thick and emulsified.
Mayo: season with salt.
Ranch: whisk mayo, sour cream, and buttermilk until smooth.
Ranch: stir in seasonings and whisk to combine.
Ranch: adjust consistency with buttermilk and flavor with lemon juice.
Ranch: chill for 30 minutes before serving. Tastes even better the next day.
title: Homemade Ranch Dressing (with Homemade Mayo)

ingredients: Sandwich toppings: Colby Jack and mozzarella cheese blend
instructions: Preheat the grill: get a chimney of coals hot, dump into the tray, and let the cast iron sit over the coals for about 10 minutes.
Cube the chuck and season with salt + pepper. Add about 2 tbsp olive oil to the pot and sear the cubes, flipping occasionally, until all sides get a good sear.
Blend all the remaining ingredients (except bay leaves) in a blender or food processor, then dump into the pot. Add the bay leaves and close the lid.
After about 4 hours, the chuck should have reached 200°F+ and be pull-apart tender. Separate the consommé from the beef.
Remove the pot, set a new round of coals, and place a skillet on the tray. Butter the skillet and toast the bread, then build the sandwich. Cut and dip in consommé and cilantro.
title: Beef Barbacoa Grilled Cheese

ingredients: 1 tsp each cumin and dried cilantro
7 oz chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
instructions: Season the chuck roast with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat with a couple of tbsp of butter and sear the roast on all sides.

Put the roast in a slow cooker. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, chili powder, and cayenne. Add the onion, beef broth, minced garlic, green chiles, and chipotle peppers in adobo. Stir together.
Cook on low for 7 or 8 hours. Remove the meat, shred with two forks, and discard extra fat.
Carefully add the juices and chipotle peppers from the slow cooker to a blender. Blend the sauce and set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium heat with some oil. Lay out tortillas, top with shredded cheese and a spoonful of meat. Fold and cook on both sides until golden brown and crispy.
Lay tacos on paper towels to absorb extra grease. Top with your favorite toppings and dip in the sauce.
title: Crockpot Chipotle Shredded Beef Tacos

ingredients: 1/3 cup oil (avocado oil or bacon grease)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all the dry ingredients, then add in the wet. Combine until well mixed and it turns into a dough.
Cover the dough with a warm towel and let it sit for 30 minutes.
Shape the dough into small balls, put back into the bowl, and re-cover with a new warm towel for 15 minutes. Flour your surfaces.
Set a pan over medium-ish heat. Roll out the balls on a floured surface and cook each one 30 seconds to a minute on each side, keeping an eye on them.
Store in a ziplock bag in the fridge for up to a week.
title: Flour Tortillas

ingredients: Low-salt option: onion powder, garlic powder, pepper, and smoked paprika instead of the AP seasoning
instructions: Set oven to 300°F.
Score hot dogs in a cross-stitch pattern to get the pinecone look.
Lather on mustard/mayo and season with AP seasoning first, then smoked paprika.
Place dogs on a warming rack and cook 30–45 minutes, or until the crust sets and the hot dogs open up.
On the stovetop, combine butter, brown sugar, and Gold sauce and mix.
Cut dogs into thirds, place in a cast iron skillet scored-side up, and evenly lather on the BBQ mixture.
Increase oven temp to 350°F and let the pinecones sit another 30 minutes, or until you're satisfied with the char.
Remove and let sit about 10 minutes. Enjoy.
title: Hot Dog Pinecones

ingredients: Beef: 1 heaped tbsp tomato puree (tomato paste)
Seasoning: 1 tsp each onion powder, garlic powder, oregano
Seasoning: 1/2 tsp each sugar, cayenne pepper
Tacos: favorite taco toppings (lettuce, tomato, avocado, etc.)
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C / 400°F.

Add oil to a large pan over medium-high heat and add the beef. Break it up, and when it begins to brown, stir in the seasoning and continue frying until cooked. Add tomato puree and water and fry another minute until the water soaks up and the beef is thick and juicy. If you have time, leave to cool until it stops steaming.

Line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Slice one pastry sheet into 8 even rectangles, then slice 2 more out of the second sheet. Sprinkle the cheese in 10 mounds in the same shape as the pastry (just a bit smaller), then top with beef. Place the pastry over the top, press around the outside to secure the filling, and brush with egg wash.
Bake 15 minutes, or until deep golden and crispy. Meanwhile, make the sauce by combining sour cream + sriracha.
Flip the pastries over (slide a spatula underneath; if the paper sticks, cut around each pastry, flip individually, and remove the paper). Add toppings and enjoy.
title: Upside Down Puff Pastry Tacos

instructions: Brown the breakfast sausage in a pan, then set aside to cool.
Chop the pepper jack cheese and Velveeta into cubes about 1 inch wide.
Add the cubes of cheese to the bottom of an oven-safe dish and place the block of cream cheese on top.
Pour in both cans of Ro-Tel, then add the crumbled breakfast sausage.
Sprinkle the chopped cilantro over the top, season with taco seasoning, then pour in 8 oz of beer.
Smoke at 300°F for about an hour, then stir until well combined and smoke for 30 more minutes.
Serve immediately alongside tortilla chips or crackers.
title: Smoked Texas Queso

ingredients: 2 chipotles in adobo sauce plus 1 tsp sauce
1 jalapeño, cut into chunks (leave seeds in, or remove them)
1 tsp guajillo chili powder (or any chili powder)
instructions: Combine chilis, garlic, onion, and jalapeño in a food processor and pulse until roughly chopped.
Add tomatoes, lime juice, cilantro, chili powder, and salt. Continue to pulse until uniform but still slightly chunky.
Taste and adjust seasoning as necessary.
Serve with tortilla chips, on eggs, or on tacos.
title: 5-Minute Salsa

ingredients: Rub amounts are per 5 lbs of meat
A few tbsp red pepper flakes (optional)
instructions: Rub and coat the entire slab of meat, then place in sealed, airtight bags for 7 days, flipping them over every day.
After 7 days, pull out of the bags and rinse under water well. Pat dry and add any additional seasonings if desired.
Place in the smoker at 160–170°F for around 6 hours, or until the meat reaches 155°F internal temp. (Or bake in the oven at 200°F until it reaches 155°F internal.)
Take off the smoker, place back in the fridge uncovered until fully cooled. Then slice and package.
title: Homemade Bacon (Rub & Cure)

instructions: Cook the bacon and sausage, and make scrambled eggs.
Slice Hawaiian rolls in half and add American cheese to the bottom of the rolls.
Add browned sausage and scrambled eggs, and top with shredded Colby Jack cheese.
Top with crispy bacon and put the tops of the Hawaiian rolls on.
In a bowl, mix melted butter and syrup. Brush this on top of the rolls.
Sprinkle Everything but the Bagel seasoning on top.
Bake at 350°F for about 15 minutes.
Serve with extra syrup for dipping.
title: Breakfast Sliders

ingredients: Topping: whipped cream and extra caramel
instructions: Fill your blender with the ice cubes, caramel sauce, milk, and espresso.
Blend, then pour into your final cup.
Top with whipped cream and extra caramel if you like.
title: Caramel Frappuccino
Easy Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 (10.5 ounce) can cream of chicken soup
3 chicken breasts, pre-cooked & cut up (or use a rotisserie chicken)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Combine sour cream, soup, and chilies in a bowl.
Take 3/4 cup of the soup mixture and slather the entire bottom of a 9x13 casserole dish. This thin layer keeps the enchiladas from sticking.
In each tortilla, layer soup mixture, cheese, and chicken.
Roll up and place in the casserole dish.
Top with the remaining soup mixture and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly and the cheese is melted.

title: Favorite healthy pizza toppings (listed in order)
ingredients: 3 1/2 - 4 cups of gluten-free all purpose flour (or whole wheat flour for non-gluten free recipe)
instructions: Mix warm water and Splenda in a bowl. Stir in oil, salt and yeast. Mix in egg and quinoa. Blend in the flour, starting with 3 1/2 cups. Test the dough for stickiness. If the dough sticks to your hands but pulls off you have enough flour for the dough. If the dough is too sticky add small amounts of flour and continue to test for stickiness. You should not need more than 4 cups total. Slice the dough in half for 2 large crusts. You can freeze the 2nd half in zip lock freezer bag or make 2 large pizzas. Place the dough in a bowl sprayed with Pam and cover with a clean kitchen towel. Place in a warm area to sit for 15 min.
Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Lightly grease pizza pan(s) with Pam and press the dough evenly in pan(s). Top with healthy pizza toppings and bake in the center oven rack for 25 to 30 min.
Favorite healthy pizza toppings (listed in order)
- 1 small can of low sodium pizza sauce
- Basil and oregano sprinkled over pizza
- Partly skimmed mozzarella cheese
- Extra lean ground turkey (I also used turkey peperoni on my husband's half)
- Fresh sliced tomatoes, mushrooms and olives
Each crust makes 12 slices

title: Cioppino
ingredients: 1 lb. crab legs, cut into 4-inch pieces
1 lb. medium shrimp (30-40 per lb.) peeled and deveined
1 lb. firm white fish fillet, such as cod or halibut
Salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat oil in heavy soup pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion and green pepper; cook, stirring until softened. Add garlic and cook until aromatic, about 1 minute. Stir in wine and bring to a boil; cook for 3 minutes then add tomatoes, clam juice, parsley, bay leaf, oregano and crushed red pepper. Cover, leaving the lid slightly ajar; simmer, stirring occasionally, until broth is rich and thick, 20 to 30 minutes

Add mussels, cover and cook 2 minutes. Remove the mussels with tongs as they open, reserving them in a large bowl. Discard any mussels that do not open. Add crab legs, return to a simmer and cook, uncovered until the crab is heated through, about 5 minutes. Remove with tongs and reserve along with the mussels. Add shrimp, fish and chopped basil; cook and simmer until the shrimp turns pink and the fish is opaque, 2 to 3 minutes. Discard the bay leaf. Taste and adjust the seasonings with salt and pepper. Return the reserved mussels and crab legs to the pot. Reheat briefly and serve.

title: Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1 pound orange roughy or other boneless, skinless fish fillet, such as red snapper
instructions: To make the fish: Place the fish in a shallow baking dish and sprinkle with the lime juice, paprika, salt, black pepper, and chili powder (if desired). Cover, refrigerate, and marinate for about 30 minutes.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (or preheat the oven to 375°F).

Lightly coat a 24" x 12" piece of foil with olive oil cooking spray. Place the fish in a single layer in the center of the foil. Fold the foil over and fold the ends upward to seal in the fish. Place the foil packet on the preheated grill. Cook for 7 to 10 minutes, or until the fish is opaque. Remove from the grill.

To assemble the tacos: Wrap the tortillas in foil and place them on the grill to warm for 2 minutes. Spread about one-eighth of the mashed avocado on each tortilla and top with one-eighth of the fish. Sprinkle each with cheese, salsa, cilantro, cabbage, and hot sauce, if desired. Serve with glasses of ice water garnished with a slice of orange and a sprig of fresh mint. Makes about 8 (1-taco) servings
Per serving: 140 calories, 18 g protein, 13 g carbohydrates (1 g sugars), 5 g fat (less than 1 g saturated), 30 mg cholesterol, 8 g fiber, 480 mg sodium

title: Carne Asada
ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoons chipotle chile pepper (the one in a jar in the spice aisle)
18 ounces trimmed top round steak, preferably grass fed (see note)
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the cocoa powder, chili powder, chipotle chile pepper, paprika, and salt until well combined.

Place the steak on a clean, flat work surface. Using the toothed side of a meat mallet, tenderize the steak by pounding both sides to a 1/8" thickness (it can have some small holes in it but shouldn't be so flat it tears apart). Rub the oil over all of the steak, then rub the seasoning mixture evenly over that. Allow the steak to stand for 15 to 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, preheat a grill to high heat. When hot, grill the steak for 45 seconds to 1 minute per side for medium-rare. Transfer to a plate and tent with foil (place the foil loosely over the top) for 10 minutes. Cut across the grain into thin slices and serve immediately.
Per serving: 145 calories, 28 g protein, 2 g carbohydrates (trace sugar), 6 g fat, 2 g saturated fat, 56 mg cholesterol, 1 g fiber, 227 mg sodium

title: Steamed Salmon and Asparagus with Mustard Dill Sauce
ingredients: 1-1/2 lb salmon filet, skin and bones removed and cut into 4 pieces
salt and white pepper to taste
1 TBS prepared mustard such as Dijon
instructions: Bring 2 inches of lightly salted water to a boil in a steamer with a tight fitting lid.

While water is coming to a boil, put all sauce ingredients except olive oil in a blender and begin to blend on high speed for about one minute. While blender is running, drizzle olive oil in a little at a time. Set aside.

Snap off tough asparagus ends. When water is at a full boil place asparagus in steamer basket, cover, and cook until asparagus is tender, about 3-5 minutes, depending on thickness. Remove from steamer, toss with 1 TBS lemon juice, 1 TBS olive oil, salt and pepper.
Place salmon in the same steamer basket and steam until pink inside, about 3-4 minutes. Place salmon on a plate and pour desired amount of sauce over it and the asparagus.

title: Crêpes
time: Prep time: 10 mins · Cook time: 10 mins · Total time: 20 mins
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose gluten-free flour (I use Better Batter)
¼ teaspoon xanthan gum (omit if using Better Batter)
2 extra-large eggs, lightly beaten and at room temperature
1½ cups milk (low-fat is fine, nonfat is not; non-dairy is fine) at room temperature, plus more
instructions: In a large bowl, place the flour, xanthan gum and salt and mix to combine. Add the eggs and butter, blending well after each ingredient.

In a slow and steady stream, add 1½ cups milk while whisking to combine. Continue to whisk the mixture until the batter is smooth. The batter should be thin and not very elastic, as well as pourable. Add more milk if necessary to reach the right consistency.

Place a 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, and ladle ¼ cup of batter into the pan, swirling to spread the batter evenly and thinly. Allow the batter to cook until set but not crispy (about 1 to 2 minutes), and flip with a wide spatula. Allow the other side to cook for about another 30 seconds.
Remove the pancake from the pan and cover with a moistened tea towel. Repeat with the remaining pancakes and stack them, covered.

Fill each pancake with your desired filling, fold into thirds as tightly as you can, and enjoy. As long as the pancakes are still rather warm when you fill them, they should hold shut even if you don’t add cheese or cream as a filling.
If using one of the bean flour mixes, like Bob’s Red Mill all-purpose gluten-free flour, you will need to tinker with the flour volume a bit to reach the desired consistency.
For chocolate crêpes, add one tablespoon sugar plus 3 or 4 tablespoons cocoa powder to the batter, and additional milk to reach the desired consistency.

title: Shepherd’s Pie
ingredients: sea salt and fresh cracked pepper to taste
1 head cauliflower, cut into florets and steamed 15 minutes
instructions: Heat a large cast iron or oven proof skillet with 2 tablespoons oil.
Saute the onion and carrots, until onions are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add your meat and cook until mostly browned. Add the mushrooms and garlic. Cook for another 3-4 minutes to soften mushrooms.
De-glaze the pan with red wine.
Stir in the tomato paste, stock and herbs. Cook down for another 3-5 minutes until some of the liquid cooks out and it thickens slightly.
Lastly, stir in the peas. Give it a quick taste and season accordingly with salt and pepper.
Spread the cauliflower mash evenly on top.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until lightly golden and bubbly.
*if you do not have a dutch oven or oven proof skillet, just transfer the cooked meat mixture to a casserole dish, cover with mashed cauliflower and bake accordingly.

title: Bison Burgers
instructions: In a large bowl, use clean hands to mix the bison meat and spices together until well-seasoned. Form 4 large patties, each 3 inches in diameter and ½ inch thick.
Preheat a grill, a grill pan or a George Foreman Grill over medium-high heat, about 5 minutes. Brush the grill surfaces with olive oil.
Grill the bison burgers 4 minutes on each side for medium-rare (4 minutes total on a George Foreman grill) or 5 minutes for medium. Serve immediately.

title: Barbacoa Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs. beef eye of round or bottom round roast, all fat trimmed
instructions: Place garlic, onion, lime juice, cumin, oregano, chipotles and cloves in a blender and blend well

Trim all fat off the meat and cut into 4-inch chunks. Season with salt and pepper and brown on high heat in 1 tsp. of oil on all sides for ~5 minutes. Add liquefied spices, water, bay leaves and simmer on low for 2 hours in a pressure cooker or crockpot

Once cooked and the meat is tender, remove the meat and place in a dish. Shred it with two forks, and reserve the liquid for later (discard the bay leaf). Return the shredded meat to the pot , adjust salt and cumin (you may need to add more) to taste and add some of the reserved liquid back. Simmer uncovered for about 10 minutes to let the flavors penetrate

title: Lemon Protein Bars
ingredients: 1 cup oat flour 2 scoops vanilla whey protein 1/4 tsp salt 1/2 tsp baking soda 2 qt mix Crystal Light (preferably without aspartame) 4 egg whites 1/2 cup Splenda, Truvia, or Ideal 8 oz baby food applesauce 4 oz water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Mix oat flour, vanilla whey protein, salt, baking soda and crystal light, in large bowl.
Mix egg whites, Splenda, Truvia, or Ideal, applesauce and water in a bowl.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and mix together.
Spray 8x8 glass Pyrex dish with non-stick butter spray.
Pour ingredients into dish.
Bake 23 minutes.

title: Chicken Chili
time: Prep Time: 25 minutes · Cook Time: 4 1/2 Hours on High in Crockpot
ingredients: 3 15-ounce cans of Great Northern, pinto, or cannellini (white kidney) beans, rinsed and drained
2 1/2 cups chopped cooked chicken (dark or white meat or a mix)
1 1/2 cups chopped red, green, and/or yellow sweet pepper (2 medium) I love to use a mixture of all 3!
2 fresh jalapeno chile peppers, seeded and chopped (wash your hands very well after working with these peppers!
3 1/2 cups chicken broth (I use the low sodium one)
Shredded Raw Monterey Jack cheese (optional)--Or any Raw cheese that suits your tastes

title: Tortilla Soup
instructions: Combine all of the above in a pot and season to taste with salt and pepper. Bring to a boil and simmer for 25 min
Then add:
1 Zucchini diced
2 medium Tomatoes
2 Chicken breasts shredded
Simmer all together for additional 10 min.
Remove from heat and serve. Can be served with Beanito Chips, Avocado and Cilantro
Macros per cup:
Cal 95 Protein 7g
Carb 10g Fat 0g

title: paleo hash
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp extra-virgin olive oil (or oil of choice)
Optional: 4 pieces nitrate-free bacon, pre-cooked and chopped
Himalayan sea salt and freshly ground pepper, to taste
instructions: In a skillet, sauté oil and garlic over medium heat for 1 minute
Add in chopped sweet potato and stir
After 4-5 minutes, add in peppers, onion, and tomato
Let sauté for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally
Mix in chopped sausage and bacon, let cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring often
Mix in fresh spinach, and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until sautéed

title: carrot cake
ingredients: 1 cup oat flour • 2 scoops vanilla whey protein • 2 tsp cinnamon • 1/2 tsp baking soda • 1/4 tsp salt • 1/8 tsp allspice • 1/8 tsp nutmeg • 4 egg whites • 3/4 cup Splenda, Truvia, or Ideal • 8 oz baby food carrots • 4 oz water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Mix flour, whey protein, cinnamon, allspice, nutmeg, baking soda and salt together in a bowl.
Mix egg whites, Splenda, Truvia, or Ideal, baby food carrots and water (optional) in a bowl.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and mix together.
Spray glass pyrex dish with non-stick butter spray.
Pour ingredients into dish.
Bake 20-30 minutes.

title: Carrot cake (overnight oats)
instructions: "Carrot cake #zoats" with cream cheese frosting. This was sooooo good, you really have to try it!! 😃 A little more than 1/3 cup oats (35g) 2 tbsp carrot puree (babyfood) 1 tbsp shredded carrot 1/2 cup finely shredded zucchini 1 tsp vanilla extract 1 tsp cinnamon 2 tsp psyllium seed (optional) 1 egg white 2/3-1 cup water Optional: Sweetener ℹPut all ingredients except egg whites in a pot and cook for about 3-4 min. Add egg white while stirring. Cook for another 2-3 min. For the strawberry cream I used a hand blender to mix: 1/3 cup cottage cheese 1/3 cup greek yoghurt 1 tbsp low fat cream cheese 2 tsp granulated sweetener 1/2 tsp vanilla extract Nutritional stats for only zoats: 169kcal, 9g protein, 24 g carbs, 4 g fat With cream cheese-topping: 303 kcal, 29g protein, 30g carbs, 6 g fat

title: Low Cal Lasagna
ingredients: 9 oz. pkg. frozen spinach (cooked as directed and drain excess water)
1 cup fat free mozzarella cheese (1/2c part skim mozzeralla)
instructions: This recipe submitted by Vicki Ahlstrom.Great thing about this is that you can add or substitute a lot of the ingredients to make it just a little different each time. I know it's not one of those super pretty lasagnas where the cook carefully layers each ingredient, but it's still wonderful!
Cook ground beef until brown.
Boil noodles as directed by package.
Spray a 9”x13” pan with cooking spray and spread a few tablespoons of the spaghetti sauce on the bottom of the pan.
Mix the rest of the ingredients, except for the fat free mozzarella cheese.
Lay down ½ of the noodles and top with half of the cottage cheese mixture.
Layer with the rest of the noodles and top with the other half of the mixture.
Lastly, put the fat free cheese on top.
Bake at 350 for 35-40 minutes.

title: CROCK POT CHICKEN STEW
ingredients: 1 CAN (15 OZ.) LOW SODIUM DICED TOMATOES
instructions: Add to crockpot and cook on low for 6 hours or until the celery and yams are soft.

title: Pesto Pizzettas
ingredients: 1 tube (24 ounces) precooked, ready-to-heat polenta (see note), cut into twelve 1/2" slices
2 tablespoons Basil Pesto or bottled pesto (see note)
1/4 roasted red bell pepper, cut into thin strips
3/4 cup shredded low-or reduced-fat mozzarella or Italian cheese blend Fresh basil or thyme
instructions: Spray the polenta slices lightly with olive oil cooking spray and place them on a baking sheet. Bake the polenta for 8 minutes. While it's baking, place all the toppings in small bowls for quick and easy assembly. Turn the polenta slices over and bake for 8 minutes longer. Remove the polenta from the oven and turn on the broiler.
Top each baked polenta round with 1 teaspoon of marinara sauce. Add 1/2 teaspoon of pesto, a strip of roasted bell pepper, artichoke slices, and 1 tablespoon of cheese.

Broil the pizzettas for about 3 minutes, or just until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and light golden. Remove the pizzettas from the oven and top them with the fresh herbs. Serve immediately. Leftovers reheat well the next day!
Bottled pesto is slightly higher in calories and fat.
Per serving: 80 calories, 4 g protein, 10 g carbohydrates (1 g sugars), 2 g fat (1 g saturated), 5 mg cholesterol, 1 g fiber, 68 mg sodium

title: Spontaneous Pork Ramen
ingredients: Kosher salt and cracked black pepper
1 large garlic clove, peeled and thinly sliced
1/2 cup sliced mushrooms, sliced and then julienned
1 baby bok choy, leaves chiffonade, bottom sliced thin
instructions: Flavoring the stock. Heat up the stock in a large saucepan at a medium simmer. Add the fish sauce, oyster sauce, tamari, chile flakes, and rice wine vinegar into the stock. Keep it bubbling, at a slow simmer, while you finish the rest of the dish.

Searing the pork. Season the pork slices with salt and pepper. Bring a large sauté pan to high heat. Get it screaming-ass hot, as the Chef likes to say. Pour in the oil. Put the thin strips of pork in the hot oil. Sear one side of the pork pieces, and then the other. Remove the pork from heat. Drop the pork into the simmering stock.

Sautéing the vegetables. Bring the sauté pan back to medium-high heat. Drop the onions into the leftover oil and goodness from the pork. When the onions have started to soften, put in the mushrooms, garlic, and the roots of the bok choy. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the onion has become soft and translucent. Add the Thai basil. Cook until it releases its fragrance. Spoon all the sautéed vegetables into the stock as well.

Cooking the rice sticks. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. (The water should taste like the ocean.) When the water is full roiling boil, drop in the rice sticks. Cook about 5 minutes, or until they are soft with a bit of bite left (al dente). Drain the rice sticks. Put them in the fragrant pork and vegetable stock now too.

Finishing the ramen. Put the ginger into the stock and bring the liquid to a boil. Taste the broth. Is it what you want? Season with salt and pepper, if necessary, plus any flavorings you feel are missing. Toss in the bok choy leaves and remove the pan from the heat.
Divvy up the ramen into bowls. Toss in the julienned carrot. Top with the daikon sprouts and cucumber.

title: Huevos Rancheros
ingredients: 1/2 can black beans, drained and mashed
sea salt and pepper, to taste
salsa from a jar, to taste
instructions: Heat beans in a skillet while eggs are cooking
Remove beans from heat and mix in olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper Add a pinch of cayenne for spicy beans
Place beans on plate, top with poached eggs, avocado, salsa, cheese and cilantro

title: Turkey Meatloaf Muffins
servings: Serving Size: Women: 2 muffins Men: 4 muffin
ingredients: 2 lbs ground turkey (or chicken) • 3 egg whites • 1 cup quick cooking oats • 1/2 tsp ground cumin • 1/2 tsp dried thyme • 2 tsp dry yellow mustard • 2 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp chipotle pepper spice • 1 tsp salt • 2 tbsp garlic powder (2 cloves minced) • 1 small onion (finely chopped) • 2 celery stalks (finely chopped)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Spray muffin pan with canola or olive oil.
Mix all your ingredients together in one large bowl.
Roll the mixture into balls and place in muffin pan. Muffins should be about the size of a racquetball.
Bake for 40 minutes.

title: Garlic Southern Fried Chicken
ingredients: 4 small bone-in chicken breasts (approximately 7 to 8 ounces each), trimmed of skin and visible fat (see note)
2 teaspoons all-natural salt-free garlic herb seasoning or your favorite all-natural salt-free seasoning (I used Spice Hunter Salt Free Garlic Herb Bread Blend)
1/2 teaspoon salt, plus more to taste, if desired
1 cup all-natural whole wheat panko-style bread crumbs
instructions: Add the chicken breasts and buttermilk to a large resealable plastic bag or container. Rotate the breasts so they are completely coated, then seal the bag or container. Marinate them in the refrigerator at least 6 hours or overnight, rotating them once or twice.
Preheat the oven to 450°F. Lightly mist a medium nonstick baking sheet with spray.
In a small bowl, mix the seasoning and salt.
Add the panko to a medium shallow bowl.

Remove 1 chicken breast from the buttermilk. Let any excess buttermilk drip off it, then sprinkle the entire breast (both sides) evenly with about one-quarter of the seasoning mixture. Dip the chicken in the panko, rotating it to cover completely. Place the breaded chicken breast face down (ribs up) on the prepared pan. Repeat with the remaining breasts, arranging them on the baking sheet so they do not touch.

Lightly mist the chicken with spray. Bake for 10 minutes, then gently flip the breasts, being careful not to remove any breading. Lightly mist them again with spray and continue to bake for 12 to 15 minutes longer, or until the breading is crispy and the chicken is no longer pink inside. Sprinkle with additional salt, if desired. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 2 days to eat cold.

title: EZ cajun halibut
ingredients: 1 (8-oz) can tomato sauce with roasted garlic
1 (1 1/4-lb) halibut fillet, cut into 4 equal pieces
Large microwaveable bowl, shallow microwavable shallow baking dish
instructions: Mix bell peppers, fennel, onion and Cajun seasoning in large microwaveable bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and vent one corner. Microwave on high until tender, 4-5 minutes, stirring once after 2 minutes. Pour off any liquid.
Stir in tomato sauce and tomato. Microwave, uncovered, on high until heated through, 2-3 minutes. Cover and keep warm.

title: chicken tenders

title: Light Turkey Chili with White Beans (Crockpot)
ingredients: 3 (15.8-ounce) cans of Great Northern beans, rinsed and drained
2 (15.8-ounce) cans of Cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
4 cups (32-ounce) fat-free, Nature’s Promise Culinary Stock
2 lbs Fresh Perdue Lean Ground Turkey
1/3 cup chopped fresh basil (You can use cilantro if you want)
instructions: Heat 1/2 tablespoon of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add onions and sauté for 10 minutes or until tender and golden. Add your chili powder, garlic and cumin then continue to sauté for another 2-3 minutes. In your crockpot heat up the last 1/2 tablespoon of your oil and add your onion mix to the crockpot. Once added, put in the oregano and beans, cook for 30 seconds. Add your diced tomato, chopped fresh basil or cilantro, lime juice, brown sugar, salt, and pepper, stirring well into the crockpot. Now add your broth and bring to a simmer. Cook for about 20 minutes.

Place 3 cups of bean mixture from crockpot in a blender or food processor. Process until nice and smooth. Add the pureed mixture back into the crockpot. Now in your pan, add turkey, and cook for 5-7 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Once turkey is cooked add it into your crockpot and cook on low for 4-8 hours. Garnish with lime wedges and fresh basil for a fancier look!

Tip: For a Thicker sauce add cornstarch, a few teaspoons at a time. It won’t change the flavor, just the thickness. If you’re looking for more carbs you can even make a side dish of rice and pour your chili on-top for an extra filler,

title: Spaghetti Squash with Basil & Parsley
ingredients: half a bunch of basil chopped
3 cloves of garlic, crushed or finely chopped
instructions: Pre- heat oven to 350 F or 180 C
Cut spaghetti squash lengthwise scoop out seeds
Pierce a few times around the flesh
Rub first with a little olive oil all over (including skin) - I did a quick spray with canned stuff.
then rub with a little himalayan salt all over.
Place in baking tray, flesh up for 30 mins.
Whilst that's doing it's thing...
Place in bowl, capers, garlic & lemon zest
Juice the lemon and add 1/2 of the amount with oil ( I only used not even a tablespoon) whisk to combine, put that in the bowl and mix (this will taper the garlic taste down)
Chop: basil, parsley (& dandy leaves*), walnuts, and sundried tomatoes... add to the bowl
Sprinkle with 1 tsp himalayan salt.
Mix well to combine.
Take out the squash from oven (you can allow it to cool so easier to handle)
Then with a fork close to the skin pull the flesh toward the centre and it strands like sketti! Keep scraping until all flesh is used.
Place in a larger bowl and then mix in the "salad".
Chill for an hour and eat.. Yum! I got 4 - 6 decent servings out of a small squash.
It would be nice served with a bit of chicken or turkey on the side.

title: shrimp linguine gf
ingredients: 1 ½ pounds cherry tomatoes, slow roasted (see note below)
generous pinch of red pepper flakes
1 pound dried gluten-free linguine (we like the Bionaturae brand)
1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
½ cup dry white white wine
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil and salt generously. The water should taste like the ocean.

Place the olive oil and garlic in a large frying pan over low heat. Cook the garlic slowly for 8 to 10 minutes, or until softened but now browned. Add the tomatoes and red pepper flakes and stir to combine them with the garlic slices. Cover the pan and let the tomatoes heat slowly for a few minutes.

Add the pasta to the boiling water, stir to separate, and cook according to the manufacturer’s instructions until al dente. (Danny and I have found that packages of gluten-free pasta often instruct you to cook them much longer than is necessary. The Bionaturae package is the only one that seems right to us — 7 minutes. All the others have you cook the pasta until it is pulpy.)

When the pasta is done, drain it from the pot, saving about 1 cup of the water in which it was cooked. Immediately run cold water over the pasta, which stops the cooking process. Pour a glug of olive oil over the pasta and toss it. Set it aside and finish the sauce.

Raise the heat under the frying pan to medium-high and add the shrimp. Cook, stirring frequently, for 3 minutes, or until the shellfish have turned opaque. Raise the heat to high and pour in the wine. Let it bubble for a minute or so, or just until the shellfish are completely cooked. Scoop a ladleful of cooking water from the pasta pot and stir it into the frying pan. Taste and season with salt, if needed. Turn off the heat.

Transfer the pasta to the frying pan and gently toss the pasta and sauce to combine thoroughly, adding a splash or two more of the cooking water if necessary to loosen the sauce. Transfer the dressed pasta to warmed shallow individual bowls and serve immediately.

To slow-roast the tomatoes: slice cherry tomatoes in half, spread across a baking sheet covered in parchment paper, pour a glug of olive oil over the top, then sprinkle salt and fresh thyme on top. Toss. Cook in a 275° oven until the cherries are slightly shrunken and have released their juices, about 2 hours.

title: BBQ Chicken Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.
Bake the naan for 3-5 minutes directly on the oven rack (or on an oven safe rack fitted into a half baker’s sheet), or until beginning to get crispy.
Meanwhile, mix 2-3 tablespoons of the barbecue sauce with the chicken.
Remove from oven and top naan flatbread with the remaining BBQ sauce, followed by the cheese, chicken, and sliced onion.
Bake for 10 minutes, or until beginning to brown on top.
Top pizza with one tablespoon of chopped fresh cilantro.

1 tsp. Mrs. Dash or other salt-free seasoning

Pound chicken breasts to 1⁄4-inch thickness and sprinkle both sides with seasoning. Place one ounce of cheese and one slice of ham on each chicken breast. Roll up each breast and secure with toothpicks.

Place chicken in baking dish, seam side down, sprinkle with bread crumbs and bake for 30-35 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink inside. For added fiber and vitamins, serve with steamed broccoli or asparagus. For more carbs in a mass-gaining phase, add a whole-grain roll.

Lift the chicken onto a rack in a roasting tin and roast for 35-40 minutes, until golden. (To cook the chicken on the barbecue, reduce the cooking time to 25-30 minutes.)
Blend together the remaining yogurt and cilantro. Finely chop the cucumber and stir into the yogurt mixture. Season. Serve with the chicken and garnish with wedges of lime and salad greens.
